tasks.text: Message Leyya when you're at the gate. Use the pedestrian gate only, not the garage
Sort the washing loads and start the first load (sheets on cotton cycle, clothes on quick 30, silk by hand)
Open the blinds and draw the curtains
Clean the fireplace inside, outside, underneath and behind, plus the glass. Move the big rug aside first. Keep the cold ash for Sattiel
Main bedroom: floors, corners of floor and ceiling, behind the pedestals and dressing table, then the bathroom
Clean all toilets, the steam shower and the main shower
Empty the bins in every toilet
Kitchen: clean all counters fully, every handle and cupboard door, stove and plates, microwave, outside of fridge
Sweep, then vacuum every rug (gently on the big fireplace rug); include dining, lounge, kitchen and front-door rugs
Sweep and mop the whole house, prayer room and spare bedroom (Dettol tile cleaner + 1 cap of Dettol)
Wipe the leather lounge suite with a damp cloth (no soap)
Use the cat-hair gadget on every chair: 8 dining, 3 fireplace, 2 prayer room, 2 kitchen stools
Wipe all window sills and all light switches
Dust the corners and ceiling edges with the microfibre duster
Wipe the 2 brass tables by the fireplace
Gym: sweep and mop, wipe equipment with damp cloth + Handy Andy, clean the mirrors
Laundry: wipe all surfaces clean of fluff
Cat litter by the front door: clear the mess with the spade (don't change the litter)
Outside: sweep and mop front patio and the side by the dining room; dust and neaten the pool patio
Clean the wooden patio table properly and dust the 2 benches
Finish ALL the ironing (low heat on black and delicate items; don't burn anything)
Change Leyya's sheets (iron the fresh sheets before putting them on)
Wash all windows: inside with plain water, outside with soap and water
Clean every door and handle with a cloth + Handy Andy, especially along the handle side
Deep clean the laundry: walls, cupboards, floor tiles, sink and laundry toilet
Shine all brass (trays, pot holders, ash container) with Brasso and silver with Silvo
Shine all mirrors in the house and wipe the sliding doors on the inside
Deep clean kitchen cupboards: unpack, clean, repack (not the grocery cupboard)
Deep clean the steam room
Clean inside the fridge; put anything expired or off on the side counter
Deep clean the prayer room and office, including under the bookshelf
Spare bedroom: clean properly, check under the bed, remove cat hair from the bedding
Remove lounge cushions, clean underneath, dust off the blankets outside
Neaten the closet and hang anything that needs hanging
Dust all light fittings and globes, and the aircon vents
Scrub the grout in the kitchen, bathrooms and steam shower
Run the washing machine empty with 2 cups of white vinegar; clean the dryer lint filter and vent
Wipe skirting boards and the walls around light switches, frames and the staircase
Condition the leather lounge suite with leather conditioner
Dust or vacuum all curtains and blinds
Wash duvets, blankets, and the cat blankets and beds
Clean the oven, stove burners and trays; degrease the extractor hood filter
Clear the sink, shower and bath drains
Vacuum and turn the mattresses; wash the pillows
Wipe down the walls in every room
Empty, wipe and repack the grocery cupboard (bay leaves on the shelves keep insects away)
Take down and wash the curtains (or tell Leyya which need sending out)
Remind Leyya: rugs are due for professional cleaning
Put all cleaning things away neatly in the laundry. No rags left in any room
Soak the kitchen cloths (left side of kitchen sink) and cleaning cloths (laundry sink)
Read this list again, then tap the WhatsApp button to report what wasn't finished
Leave by 4:30pm through the pedestrian gate
Take the bins out (on bin day)
Water all pots, starting with the upstairs deck (use the watering jug if there are water restrictions)
Clean the garden: remove dead leaves, dead flowers and buds from all beds and pots
Give extra attention to struggling plants (cycads upstairs, bougainvilleas by the pool, new plants)
Upstairs deck: sweep the astroturf, clear dead leaves, dust the couches
Sweep and dust the front patio and pool patio (around benches and sauna)
Sweep and mop all around the outside of the house and the gym (outside mop, pine gel or green Dettol tile cleaner)
Sweep the garage
Check the gym and sliding doors for ant gaps and seal with silicone
Wash Leyya's car: outside with polish on paintwork and wheels, dust the mats (inside too when asked)
Treat the 2 cypress trees for aphids/fungus and check their support ropes are straight
Feed fertiliser to flowering pots and any plant that is struggling
Clear the gutters and roofs (kitchen, garage, pedestrian door) of leaves
Empty the sumps of water and sludge; clear the drains and French drains
Run the generator for 15 minutes and check the battery is charged
Check sprinklers and irrigation: no leaks, nothing spraying furniture or tiles
Check water pipes for leaks, especially the pool patio and above the kitchen
Trim and shape: bougainvillea hedge, purple and white bushes (round), ground cover, creepers off the screens
Train the jasmine and creeping rose onto the strings
Make sure all pots drain: holes drilled and stones at the bottom
Pool: check the level (2 tiles from the top) and the creepy crawly
Wash the wheelie bins and indoor bins inside and out
Check the catios, cat shelves and roof netting; fix anything loose
Neaten the garage and tool shed; put aside anything to throw away for Leyya to check
Look around the house and report anything that needs fixing or plumbing
Test pH (7.2–7.6) and chlorine (1–3), and adjust
Test pH (7.2–7.6) and chlorine (1–3), and adjust
Empty the skimmer and pump baskets; skim the surface
Backwash 2–3 minutes, rinse 1 minute, back to filter
Brush the walls, steps and tile line
After a storm or heavy use: shock dose in the evening and run the pump
Mow the lawn
Edge the lawn borders
Feed the lawn (LAN or 5:1:5) and water it in
Check the lawn for grubs: brown patches that lift easily, birds pecking
Scarify (rake out thatch) and aerate the lawn
Autumn lawn feed (potassium-rich)
Last mow of the season at about 40mm
Water the dormant lawn (about every 3 weeks); stay off frosted grass
Prune the roses, including the creeping rose (finish by mid-August)
Main hard prune of the bougainvilleas (after the last frost)
Mulch the beds with a thick layer of compost after pruning
Feed the azaleas as they come into flower
Before the storms: flush gutters and downpipes with the hose, check joints and brackets for leaks
Run the whole irrigation system and fix leaks before summer
Service the lawnmower and clean and sharpen garden tools
Before frost: wrap the ferns, tree ferns, philodendrons and other tender plants in frost cloth; move tender pots under cover
Check frost covers are secure; cover anything exposed before cold nights
Water in the morning, not the afternoon, so plants aren't wet overnight
Remove the frost covers, cut back frost-damaged leaves, and store the cloth dry
Bring firewood bags into the storeroom by the fireplace
Keep only dry, cold ash in the HTH buckets with lids for the garden; throw away wet ash
Bring the bins back in and store them with the lids facing the door
If you drilled, clean up (always use a packet and the dustpan when drilling)
Tap the WhatsApp button to report what wasn't finished
Fill the water bowls to the top with fresh water
Dry food: just enough to cover the bottom of each bowl (1 cup split across 3 bowls)
Wet food: one flat teaspoon each, once a day
Clean both litter boxes (front door and spare bathroom); only change litter if very bad
Check the house for pee or mess and clean with Jik or Domestos
Check for water leaks or anything wrong in the house
If it's very cold, check the electric blanket is on
Give them some love (Lucy especially)
Tap the WhatsApp button so Leyya knows the cats are fed
